svg.title: Silence stays observed while ranking labels are qualified
svg.desc: Keep observed silence bright while dimming the model-derived ranking terms. The reopened dated critique stays text; the correction changes confidence in labels, not the existence of the silent lanes.

**Location:**

- `curt-home-office`
- `documentary-evidence-field`

**Frame:** The [page-064](064.md) image, unchanged, beside a plain statement of what survives the correction and what does not. `THE LANES WENT SILENT` stays lit. `ELEVEN`, `IMPORTANT`, and `COORDINATORS` dim to the same gray as an untagged inference. In the margin, the critique window from [page 039](039.md) reopens: same typeface, same size, same byline and date, scrolled to a later paragraph.

**Action:** The silence remains a fact. Its shape does not.

**Font:** `source-summary`

**Screen / system text — PUBLISHED CRITIQUE (PAGE 039, 3 SEPTEMBER 2026) (PARAPHRASED):**
`THE INVESTIGATORS HANDED THE ANALYSIS TO THE SAME KIND OF UNRELIABLE AGENT.`

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> THE READER WAS MOVED BY A RANKING.
>
> SO WAS THE BOOK. THE TAG WAS ON THE PAGE THE WHOLE TIME.

**Font:** `human`

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> He was right about the channel. He was right about the instrument, too.

**Provenance:** `inferred` + `documented` — the project's disclosure of its own construction. This is an admission, not a trick revealed; the qualifier on [page 064](064.md) was accurate and deliberately small. The critic's line is `IOB-CIV`, attributed paraphrase of the post's claim that METR delegated analysis to often-unreliable AI agents; Curt's concession is reconstructed.

", "title": "Silence stays observed while ranking labels are qualified" } }
